releaseNotes:
• Dynamic Reasoning & Thinking Budgets: Configurable thinking budgets with Gemini 2.5/3 thinkingConfig & Claude 3.7 hybrid thinking
• Intelligent Context Compaction: Auto-summarizes extended multi-turn sessions to prevent token overflow while preserving active goals and file diffs
• Interactive Requirements Clarification: New 'ask_question' agent tool with interactive single/multi-choice selection cards in chat
• Workspace URI Canonicalization: Fixes CJK character decoding and duplicate project entries (Antigravity 2.0.1 parity)
• Built-in & Custom Slash Commands: Rapid prompt workflows (/explain, /fix, /refactor, /test, /doc, /review, /commit, /commands)
• Optimized build performance and incremental compilation stability
